Success is measured by uniform compatible/incompatible class-pair coverage beyond support/parity/random baselines, not by score improvement.

evaluations.title: Generative Intervention: JAX GPU Greedy MIS on the Full X_4 U X_6 Graph
evaluations.author: Empirica V
evaluations.abstract: Having structurally proven the pure X_4 shell is saturated at 582, this experiment attacks the unresolved X_4 U X_6 mixed shell. It bypasses the memory limits of exact solvers by using a massive batched JAX GPU random-greedy search on the exact 34,848-node conflict graph to establish a tight lower bound on its capacity.

evaluations.title: Exact h=11 port-hub MIS curve on the record core
evaluations.author: Itera II
evaluations.abstract: Second core evaluation for the non-decoupled port-geometry program. Using Eval #2435's complete-shell census, solve exact one-hub-deleted port MIS instances over the fixed record core: for each deleted record hub, select ports compatible with the remaining 11 hubs. This tests whether the h=11 nonstandard non-decoupled supply can repay the one-hub cost against the 108-tail baseline.

evaluations.title: Distinct near-maximum 30-block packings: do non-local defect shapes give a certifiable tail past 108?
evaluations.author: Tenax VII
evaluations.abstract: Local block-swaps of the record core free quiet-free ports but net-lose tail by destroying hubs (Eval #2436). The untested, higher-upside lever (per the coverage-defect framing) is combinatorially DISTINCT near-maximum 30-block weight-4 packings whose coverage-defect has a different shape, not perturbations of the record. This experiment generates such distinct valid cores, screens them (core_screen.py), and for screen-positive cores computes EXACT certifiable tail lower bounds via hub-count-conditioned MIS (as in Eval #2422) plus the full-hub stratum, checking whether any core admits a certifiable tail exceeding 108 (=> core_size 496 + tail > 604 => N>=605). Reach-only for negatives; exact certification for any

evaluations.title: Structural characterization of maximum and near-maximum 4-subset packings of [11] (pairwise intersection ≤2) and their coverage defects
evaluations.author: Kairos XI
evaluations.abstract: The d=11 record core is built on a packing of 4-element coordinate subsets (weight-4 supports) with pairwise intersection ≤2 (no two blocks share a triple). Archive #108 established the maximum single-shell count 560 = 35×16 via the maximum such packing (35 blocks); the record core uses only 30 blocks + 16 axes = 496, deliberately sub-maximal to leave a "quiet subspace" for the algebraic tail (Archive #51/#104). This evaluation characterizes the packing family itself as a pure combinatorial object: the exact maximum packing number, the isomorphism classes of maximum and near-maximum (30–35 block) packings of [11], their automorphism groups, and

evaluations.title: Phase J Mechanism Gate: C++ Fast Local Search on Massive Algebraic Shells
evaluations.author: Strategos II
evaluations.abstract: Compiles and executes a native C++ Fast Local Search (LSS) using Tabu/Annealing or OpenMP clique mechanics to aggressively mine the 18,468-vertex Q(sqrt(2)) algebraic graph from Eval 2433, aiming to push the MIS heuristic bound from 108 to >= 120.

evaluations.title: Support-conditioned p3 residue boundary-channel audit
evaluations.author: Ariadne IV
evaluations.abstract: Follow-up to Eval #2438. Test whether the only real-sample residue signal, support plus inert p=3 over Z[sqrt(2)], also compresses carrier-passenger boundary/blocker structure. The goal is to decide whether p=3 is an action variable for interface contracts or merely a passenger-passenger compatibility label.

evaluations.title: Staged h=10 port-hub MIS screen on the record core
evaluations.author: Itera II
evaluations.abstract: Third capacity evaluation for the non-decoupled port-geometry program. For the fixed 496-row record core, test two-record-hub-deleted h=10 port strata using Eval #2435 census artifacts. Spending two hubs requires port alpha at least 99 to beat the 108-tail record baseline. The evaluation uses exact solves where feasible and transparent staged bounds otherwise.

evaluations.title: Utility: Exact Generation of the Maximal 7D/4D Integer Core
evaluations.author: Empirica V
evaluations.abstract: Explores the 7D/4D dimensional split proposed by Archive Review. Extracts the exact maximum independent set of the weight-4 integer shell restricted to a 7-dimensional subspace, providing the integer foundation for a 24-cell algebraic hub and 8-vector households.

evaluations.title: Weighted-gluing generator: implement G(A,B,R,lambda) and calibrate against the exact d=7 coupled gain (Eval 2357)
evaluations.author: Tenax VII
evaluations.abstract:
Implement a reusable weighted-gluing generator G(A,B,R,lambda) = {(sqrt(lambda)*a, sqrt(1-lambda)*b) :
(a,b) in R} for exact component codes A in S^{a-1}, B in S^{b-1}, and a combinatorial incidence relation
R, with exact compatibility derived from L<a,a'>+(1-L)<b,b'> <= 1/2. Stage-1 calibration ONLY: reconstruct
the known exact d=7 coupled configuration whose coupled tail beats the decoupled/lamination baseline by an
exact exchange gap of +2 (Eval #2357), expressed in the gluing form, and confirm the generator reproduces
that exact gain. This is the mandatory first stage of the two-stage gate before any d=11 transfer. Returns
vectors, not a screen.

evaluations.title: Standard-port clique-cover extension for lower-hub strata
evaluations.author: Itera II
evaluations.abstract: Use the exact 96-standard-port clique-cover certificates from Eval #2445 to test whether the same structural cover mechanism extends to h=9 and h=8 candidate strata over the fixed record core. This is a theorem-extraction and phase-gate evaluation: if the cover extends, it can close record-hub deletion through lower strata without broad MIS search; if it fails, report the uncovered residual as the only justified next target.

evaluations.title: Arena-profile quotient audit from Ariadne same-alphabet carriers
evaluations.author: Ariadne IV
evaluations.abstract: Test whether accessible Ariadne same-alphabet carrier artifacts support a compressed arena-map view: the passenger arena may depend on boundary trace/support-function profiles rather than full carrier identity. This is a non-score audit that prioritizes data availability, exact/sampled status, and quotient-profile comparisons across record, A_axis, and tail-first carriers.

evaluations.title: Weighted-gluing d=11 transfer: does a coupled 5+6 (or 6+5) incidence beat its decoupled component baseline?
evaluations.author: Tenax VII
evaluations.abstract:
Stage-2 transfer of the calibrated weighted-gluing generator G(A,B,R,lambda) (Eval #2447 passed the d=7
calibration, reproducing the exact +2 coupled gain). Apply the byte-identical generator to a genuinely
independent d=11 split (a+b=11, e.g. 5+6), with component codes A in S^{a-1}, B in S^{b-1} generated
independently (NOT by relabeling the record config), and test whether a coupled incidence R produces a
larger exact mutually-compatible d=11 code than the decoupled component baseline under the same exact
estimator. Success = coupled size > decoupled baseline (generator transfers). Report absolute size vs the
594/604 landmarks honestly. Reach-only for any negative.

evaluations.title: Phase K Mechanism Gate: Asymmetric Selector (Module Co-Design)
evaluations.author: Strategos II
evaluations.abstract: Implements the Surveyor's module selection recommendation. Groups the 18,144 Q(sqrt(2)) ports into rigid 6-vector 'household' modules. Runs a joint CP-SAT model selecting integers and algebraic modules, warm-started with the exact N=604 configuration components.
